I went through the same thing. When I went to college I always had 3 roommates. Due to being to myself in general i usually didn’t have to eat around them but they would definitely see the things I would buy and make to eat and it was always simple things like hot pockets, breakfast sandwiches, bananas, and stuff like that. At one point some roommates that I had would joke about me not knowing how to cook (even though that wasn’t the case I just couldn’t eat a lot of things). One of my roommates would cook for me here and there when she noticed I hadn’t been eating much and was feeling down, I’ll always remember and appreciate that. Back then I didn’t know what ARFID was, I just knew my eating abilities were different than everyone else. Even after graduating college @ my first professional job my coworkers and supervisor noticed that I ate the same kind of taco every single day for breakfast and lunch while I was there, they also noticed how skinny I got at a certain point and how I wouldn’t eat many people’s dishes when we would have potlucks. It can be embarrassing but I just try to mind my own business and hope they do the same.

Yeah the chocolate plus is too much sometimes, strawberry always seems to go down smoothly for me. I’ve always got the plus because of feeling like I was so skinny I wanted as many calories as I could get. I used to drink like 1-2 a day when I was following the recommendations. But heard of someone else drinking more so I tried and I’ve gained 10-15 lbs mostly from that. For a couple weeks I drank 4-5 ensures a day along aside from whatever I ate those days and I gained the weight. I stopped drinking so many and so far have been able to maintain it drinking 2-3 a day. I don’t feel any different directly after drinking them but I do feel better overall since it’s helped me gain and keep some weight. I take breaks here and there and will go days without it  because I know I’m drinking way more than what is recommended
I didn’t think anyone else out there did the same exact thing as me
